Item level

What correlates with a $100+ item selling within a week

Most sales follow a price cut

More effort, slower sales

In the Nov 4 sample, 10+ photos, a video or a long description went with slower sales, even among similarly priced items. Pro resellers may explain part of this.

Season matters

These drivers use items listed mid-September to early November, which lifts coats and sweaters and hurts shorts, swim and dresses. Use the "Listed in" filter above to compare months.

Limits

What this does not cover

  • Depop isn't measured. Its search hides sold items, so sold history can only be pulled shop by shop, and that sample was too thin (5 or fewer sales per brand).
  • Designer labels (Chanel, Celine, Burberry, Escada and about 25 more) are still being crawled and will be added.
